where.if: and (p.proj_no ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or p.proj_nm ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or c.cust_nm ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\')

mapper.sql:
select p.proj_id, p.proj_no, p.proj_nm, p.proj_type, c.cust_nm, u.user_nm as pm_user_nm, p.status, p.sop_date, (p.sop_date - #{today}::date) as sop_days, p.plan_end, p.progress_pct, (select k.task_nm from pms_task k where k.proj_id = p.proj_id and k.parent_id is null and k.status not in ('DONE', 'CANCELLED') order by k.seq limit 1) as phase_nm, g.task_nm as next_gate_nm, g.plan_start as next_gate_date, (p.plan_end - b.plan_end) as slip_days, (select count(*) from pms_task k where k.proj_id = p.proj_id and k.is_summary = 'N' and k.status in ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS') and k.plan_end < #{lateRef}) as late_cnt, d.req_cnt, d.ready_cnt, case when d.req_cnt > 0 then (d.ready_cnt * 100 / d.req_cnt)::int end as ready_pct, (select count(*) from pms_issue i where i.proj_id = p.proj_id and i.status <> 'CLOSED') as open_issue_cnt, (select count(*) from pms_issue i where i.proj_id = p.proj_id and i.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and i.severity = 'HIGH') as high_issue_cnt, (select count(*) from pms_gate_review r where r.proj_id = p.proj_id and r.status = 'IN_APPROVAL') as gate_in_approval_cnt, trim_scale(e.plan_hours) as plan_hours, h.conf_hours, h.draft_hours, case when e.plan_hours > 0 then round(h.conf_hours * 100 / e.plan_hours)::int end as burn_pct, trim_scale(e.plan_hours - h.conf_hours) as remain_hours from pms_project p join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.pm_user_id left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = p.cust_id left join lateral (select bl.plan_end from pms_baseline bl where bl.proj_id = p.proj_id order by bl.baseline_no desc limit 1) b on true left join lateral (select k.task_nm, k.plan_start from pms_task k where k.proj_id = p.proj_id and k.task_type = 'GATE' and k.status not in ('DONE', 'CANCELLED') order by k.plan_start, k.task_id limit 1) g on true cross join lateral (select count(*) filter (where x.required_yn = 'Y') as req_cnt, count(*) filter (where x.required_yn = 'Y' and x.status in ('APPROVED', 'WAIVED')) as ready_cnt from pms_deliverable x where x.proj_id = p.proj_id) d
cross join lateral (select sum(k.plan_hours) filter (where k.is_summary = 'N' and k.status <> 'CANCELLED') as plan_hours from pms_task k where k.proj_id = p.proj_id) e cross join lateral (select trim_scale(coalesce(sum(w.hours) filter (where w.status = 'CONFIRMED'), 0)) as conf_hours, trim_scale(coalesce(sum(w.hours) filter (where w.status = 'DRAFT'), 0)) as draft_hours from pms_work_log w where w.proj_id = p.proj_id) h
mapper.select: select count(*)::int as active_cnt, (count(*) filter (where coalesce(x.slip_days, 0) > 0 or x.late_cnt > 0))::int as delayed_cnt, coalesce(sum(x.gate_in_approval_cnt), 0)::int as gate_cnt, coalesce(sum(x.high_issue_cnt), 0)::int as high_cnt, (count(*) filter (where x.burn_pct > 100))::int as over_burn_cnt from () x
select * from () x where coalesce(x.slip_days, 0) > 0 or x.late_cnt > 0 order by coalesce(x.slip_days, 0) desc, x.late_cnt desc, x.proj_no limit #{limit}
order by p.sop_date nulls last, p.proj_no limit #{limit}

select p.status, count(*) as proj_cnt, count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from pms_task k where k.proj_id = p.proj_id and k.is_summary = 'N' and k.status in ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS') and k.plan_end < #{lateRef})) as late_cnt, count(*) filter (where p.plan_end - b.plan_end > 0) as slip_cnt from pms_project p left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = p.cust_id left join lateral (select bl.plan_end from pms_baseline bl where bl.proj_id = p.proj_id order by bl.baseline_no desc limit 1) b on true
group by p.status
mapper.sql:
with f as ( select p.plan_start, p.closed_on, p.status, p.proj_type from pms_project p left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = p.cust_id
)
mapper.select: select y as year, sum(s)::int as start_cnt, sum(e)::int as close_cnt from (select extract(year from plan_start)::int as y, 1 as s, 0 as e from f where plan_start is not null union all select extract(year from closed_on)::int, 0, 1 from f where status = 'CLOSED' and closed_on is not null) x group by y order by y
select proj_type, count(*)::int as proj_cnt, (count(*) filter (where status = 'ACTIVE'))::int as active_cnt from f group by proj_type order by proj_type
select count(*)::int from f where plan_start is null
select count(*) from pms_project p left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = p.cust_id

select p.proj_id, p.proj_no, k.task_id, k.task_nm, k.plan_end, k.status, k.progress_pct, (k.plan_end < #{lateRef}) as late, k.plan_start, k.act_start, k.act_end, k.task_type, k.row_ver
order by k.plan_end, k.task_id limit #{limit}
select count(*) and k.plan_end < #{lateRef}

select p.proj_id, p.proj_no, d.deliv_id, d.deliv_nm, t.task_nm, coalesce(d.due_date, t.plan_end) as due, d.status, (coalesce(d.due_date, t.plan_end) < #{lateRef}) as late
order by coalesce(d.due_date, t.plan_end), d.deliv_id limit #{limit}
select count(*)

select x.user_id, count(*) filter (where x.due < #{lateRef}) as late_cnt, count(*) filter (where x.due >= #{lateRef}) as soon_cnt from (select k.owner_user_id as user_id, k.plan_end as due from pms_task k join pms_project p on p.proj_id = k.proj_id where k.owner_user_id is not null and k.is_summary = 'N' and k.status in ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS') and p.status in ('DRAFT', 'ACTIVE', 'ON_HOLD') and k.plan_end <= #{until} union all select coalesce(d.owner_user_id, t.owner_user_id), coalesce(d.due_date, t.plan_end) from pms_deliverable d join pms_task t on t.task_id = d.task_id join pms_project p on p.proj_id = d.proj_id where coalesce(d.owner_user_id, t.owner_user_id) is not null and d.status in ('NONE', 'REJECTED') and p.status in ('DRAFT', 'ACTIVE', 'ON_HOLD') and coalesce(d.due_date, t.plan_end) <= #{until}) x group by x.user_id
mapper.sql: from pms_issue i join pms_project p on p.proj_id = i.proj_id where i.owner_user_id = #{userId} and i.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and p.status in ('DRAFT', 'ACTIVE', 'ON_HOLD')
mapper.select: select count(*)

select i.issue_id, i.proj_id, p.proj_no, i.issue_no, i.title, i.severity, i.status, i.due_date, (i.due_date < #{lateRef}) as late
order by case i.severity when 'HIGH' then 0 when 'MID' then 1 else 2 end, i.due_date nulls last, i.issue_id desc limit #{limit}
select distinct work_day from pms_work_log where user_id = #{userId} and work_day between #{from} and #{to} and status = 'CONFIRMED'
select count(*) from pms_work_log where user_id = #{userId} and work_day between #{from} and #{to}

select category_cd, trim_scale(coalesce(sum(hours) filter (where status = 'CONFIRMED'), 0)) as confirmed_hours, trim_scale(coalesce(sum(hours) filter (where status = 'DRAFT'), 0)) as draft_hours from pms_work_log where proj_id = #{projId} group by category_cd order by category_cd nulls last
select count(*) from pms_gate_review r join pms_project p on p.proj_id = r.proj_id where r.status = 'IN_APPROVAL' and p.status in ('DRAFT', 'ACTIVE', 'ON_HOLD')
